caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #40: CAPRICIOUS

capricious (adjective): changing suddenly and unpredictably.

✅ In a sentence: Sailors feared the capricious winds of the strait.
✅ Similar: fickle, erratic, mercurial
✅ Remember it: Noun: caprice = a sudden whim.
